about: G1b on the owner's B200 (T-114, D-428): the two MIG layouts qualified, so CGMH's answer to survey question 51 is covered either way. Each server runs on its own MIG instance (D-409). max_len is the context rule of serving_config.MIG_MIN_LEN for the instance; max_seqs and gpu_mem_util are starting values the run measures, not results.

layouts.name: small
layouts.why: the smallest layout that fits the pair: three of the seven compute slices

layouts.name: large
layouts.why: one larger layout: each server on a 3g.90gb instance, six of the seven compute slices
